title.en: Cold Heart on a Hot Wall

tip.en: HR rockets from 89 to 111 in just 30 seconds while you're already on an 11% grade — your cardiovascular system had no warm-up runway. Compare this to your flat recent runs where HR crept up gently over 2-3 minutes.
tip.zh: 仅30秒内心率从89飙至111，同时坡度已达11%——心血管系统毫无热身缓冲。与近期平路跑步的缓慢心率爬升相比，这是个非常陡峭的开局。

tip.en: Grades plunge to -25% and your pace hits 3:20/km territory — but HR actually ticks up 2 beats as your quads brake hard. This is your steepest downhill of the run and demands controlled cadence, not speed; the quad damage accumulates here and will cost you later in the climb.
tip.zh: 坡度骤降至-25%，配速冲到3:20/km区间，但心率反而微升2下——股四头肌正在用力制动。这是全程最陡下坡，需要控制步频而非拼速度；此处积累的股四头肌疲劳将在后续爬坡中付出代价。

tip.en: After shedding nearly 50m of altitude, you've settled to HR 125 and near-flat ground — the lowest HR of the post-start run. Use this 200m window consciously: controlled breathing here will determine how much you have for the long climb ahead.
tip.zh: 下降近50米后，心率回落至125，地形趋于平缓——这是起跑后心率的最低点。有意识地利用这200米窗口：在此调整呼吸节奏，决定着后续长坡还剩多少储备。

tip.en: Pace slows to 13-19 min/km across a 60-second stretch on 11-19% grades — you're essentially power-hiking. HR holds at 147-153, which is efficient for the grade, but the GPS scatter suggests you may be route-finding; confirm your line before this section on future attempts.
tip.zh: 在坡度11-19%的60秒路段内，配速降至13-19分钟/公里——基本处于健行状态。心率维持147-153，对该坡度而言尚属合理，但GPS轨迹散乱，可能在寻路；下次跑前确认好路线。

title.zh: 坡度冲到36%，心率逼近上限

tip.en: A 60-second wall of 25-36% grade drives HR from 155 to 164 — your run's ceiling, and 28 beats above your recent-history average. Pace is a disciplined 8-9 min/km despite the gradient, which is controlled. The concern is you're burning top-end matches on a climb that still has 400m of elevation to give.
tip.zh: 60秒内坡度达25-36%，心率从155飙至164——本次最高点，比近期平均心率高出28下。尽管坡度极大，配速仍保持在8-9分钟/公里，属于克制表现。但需注意：在距离终点还有近400米爬升的情况下，这已消耗了顶级储备。

title.en: HR Spike Off the Wall — Recovery Quality Check
title.zh: 越过峭壁后心率冲高——恢复质量检验

tip.en: HR jumps to 160-164 in the 20 seconds after the worst ramp, then holds elevated through 2.8km on sustained 5-6% grades. Watch how quickly this settles on future runs: if you can get back below 150 within 90 seconds of clearing a hard pitch, your aerobic base is strengthening.
tip.zh: 越过最难坡段后20秒内心率冲至160-164，随后在5-6%坡度的2.8公里段持续高位。关注未来跑步中心率回落速度：如果越过难坡后90秒内能降回150以下，说明有氧基础正在增强。

title.zh: 接近顶峰再次近乎停步

tip.en: A second near-stop (37 min/km and null pace readings) at 3.0km, 1117m — HR is 157 and already dropping, which hints at a brief rest or extreme slow walk rather than a gear issue. This is the highest point of the run; the fatigue accumulation from the two previous hard pitches is showing up here.
tip.zh: 在3.0公里、海拔1117米处再次出现近乎停步（37分钟/公里及空配速记录）——心率157且已开始下降，提示短暂休息或极慢走，而非节奏问题。这是全程最高点，前两段高强度坡段积累的疲劳在此显现。

title.en: Long Descent — HR Unloads Faster Than Legs
title.zh: 长下坡——心率比腿恢复得更快

tip.en: From here you drop ~70m at 10-18% grade over 3 minutes; HR plummets from 115 to below 120 within 60 seconds of the descent opening up — faster cardiac recovery than your flat recent runs would predict. Your legs, however, are carrying 131m of accumulated vert; keep cadence high and stride short to protect the knees on this final 400m.
tip.zh: 此后3分钟内以10-18%坡度下降约70米；下坡展开60秒内心率从115迅速降至120以下——心脏恢复速度快于近期平路跑步的预期。但双腿已承载全程131米累计爬升的疲劳；最后400米保持高步频、短步幅，保护膝关节。
